name: Sacred Mini Diwali Poojan Kit
description: The compact version of our Diwali Poojan Kit: all 32 essentials for Lakshmi Pujan in one box. Roli, chandan, akshat, haldi and haldi gaanth; gulal, sindoor, abeer, kamal gatta; dhaniya, kauri, laung, elaichi, supari; shahad (honey), deepak, rui baati; gulab jal, Ganga jal, kalawa, kheel, batasha, janeu; lal vastra (red cloth) and the pujan vidhi booklet; agarbatti, dhoop cone, itra and kapoor; and Ganesh ji, Lakshmi ji and Kuber ji yantras.
